scope: Develop the existing org.moos.brand launcher as Mova. Control Center remains independently owned; no edits to its worktree, package or runtime selection.

native_owners.catalogue_folders: Kicker.RootModel / AppsModel / modelForRow; All Apps remains the native recursive flat catalogue while category children retain native folders.
native_owners.favorites: Existing KAStatsFavoritesModel client, one-time import, activity links and moveRow. Native rowsMoved/modelReset/dataChanged refresh the same identity snapshot.
native_owners.search: Existing Milou.ResultsModel and enabled KRunner providers; no second index or search daemon.
native_owners.activation: Existing sourceModel.trigger, ResultsModel.run, canonical applications: direct destinations and fixed moos routes.
native_owners.windows: Existing KWin routes, native tablet state and Plasma work-area/popup ownership.
native_owners.folder_editing: Existing KMenuEdit through ProcessRunner; in-grid arbitrary folder editing is not implemented by a second catalogue writer.

behavior.layout: Home prioritizes balanced favorite rows, actual recent items and then native workspace destinations. The library uses bounded1–8 columns and complete settled rows with existing readable size tokens. Large work areas use1040x720; portrait/tablet follows available area; short outputs remain bounded.
behavior.cards: Two-line names, one accessible native action menu instead of three overflowing reorder buttons. Content-only finite spring/press feedback keeps hit rectangles fixed.
behavior.drag: Native Qt internal favorite drag proxy and theme-matched preview; native KAStats write occurs only on accepted drop. Hover, cancelled/closed launcher drop and ordinary touch scrolling preserve order. Application outward drags use native Qt URI data.
behavior.tablet: Native KWin custom signal invalidates GetAll property map. Strict booleans, absent/service-loss and malformed values remain refused. Native single-key update tuple is retained as a negative control.
behavior.themes: Existing Kirigami/Plasma palette and UI2/Quiet Glass material owners; no per-card blur, new shader, infinite animation or replacement compositor.

preservation: org.moos.brand identity and sole panel entry
personal default page, recent visibility and compact tile choice
publisher icons, native categories and KService refresh
Settings/Store/Mira/places/session/KWin destinations and native application routes
signed origin, rollback/recovery, authentication and output/theme preferences

measured_refusals.finding: Native favorite move changed the model but count/add/remove-only Instantiator observation left search identities in the previous order.
measured_refusals.repair: Observe actual rowsMoved/modelReset/dataChanged, with coalesced Qt.callLater snapshot refresh. Native drop now changes and restores exact identities/order.

measured_refusals.finding: Plasma DBus.Properties.update(key) publishes [bool] on this runtime, so strict tablet state stays false after native notify.
measured_refusals.repair: Use updateAll after custom tabletModeChanged; external typed peer proves true/false/repeat/service-loss and malformed state, alongside missing-watcher and original tuple controls.

measured_refusals.finding: Matching application/Kirigami colours can hide a different selected native SVG style in the private fixture.
measured_refusals.repair: Require native KConfig style readback plus actual source-view PlasmaTheme/palette, retaining the original wrong-style refusal.

measured_refusals.finding: Actual8-pin wide Home used7+1 while the library exposed a final icon row with clipped names. Predecessor329fe3ef full-source qualification was intentionally stopped before push/image; its36 native cases remain historical.
measured_refusals.repair: Balance favorites across their actual native count, reserve complete library rows with native SnapToRow, and prioritize recent items before secondary workspace actions. Final164 receives fresh source/native/installed qualification.

qualification.native: Existing private KWin/Plasma/Qt rig exercises real native folders, context QAction pin/restore, pointer and Qt-touch favorite drop/restore, cancelled-target drop, names/action bounds, keyboard navigation and finite/reduced motion. Exact final gate and all-family receipts are retained under test-results/mova.
qualification.old_controls: Existing wrong geometry, Backtab, category, alignment and wrong-style controls remain. Added missing row-snapshot, closed-drop guard and flattened-folder fault copies must refuse.
qualification.source_image_ci: Use the frozen commit and exact complete source/image/CI receipts. Documentation and source/native success are separate from signed OS and physical acceptance.
qualification.installed: Before capture uses actual signed1162 launcher. Any later live KPackage review has its own exact file inventory and retirement condition; it is not immutable delivery.

licenses: MovaActionMenu is a declared derivative of KDE6.8.3 ActionMenu; native favorite/activity tools are byte-identical. Preserve original authors/GPL notices and UPSTREAM_MOVA.json.
remaining: Final frozen full source/image/CI integration and combined signed release/booted readback.
Physical tablet hotplug/touch, assistive technology and demanding-device/frame-time/battery acceptance.
Direct library-folder drag editing remains with native KMenuEdit; outward desktop/panel drop needs its own physical journey.
private_evidence: test-results/mova; desktop captures/configuration/runtime inventories stay local.
